ModMetaData.name: Japanese Homestead - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Japanese Homestead, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios dress colonists in the two aura kimonos and read what the aura does to friends, foes and the wearer over several pulses; send colonists to the tea hearth, the koto and the aquarium through the game's own joy givers; read the aquarium's cost after the game's patch pass; and check that no Japanese text is left in the pass's language.
The mod under test needs no DLC and this companion declares none: the fixture is Pickle's own test-colony.
